title: Long queue for ROCM runners, also B200 and XPU queueing is observed
bug_description: ## Current Status mitigated ## Error looks like Jobs requiring following runners will be queueing: Please see: https://hud.pytorch.org/metrics ## Incident timeline (all times pacific) Started Oct 28, 2PM PDT ~1hr queueing. Notified AMD team on the issue Oct 29 5AM observing 7hrs queuing SEV is created Oct 29 5AM also observing XPU and B200 queuing Oct 30 11AM confirmed ROCm runners are no longer queueing ## User impact Rocm jobs will not start ## Root cause *What was the root cause of this issue?* ## Mitigation *How did we mitigate the issue?* ## Prevention/followups *How do we prevent issues like this in the future?* cc @jeffdaily @sunway513 @jithunnair-amd @pruthvistony @ROCmSupport @dllehr-amd @jataylo @hongxiayang @naromero77amd @seemethere @malfet @pytorch/pytorch-dev-infra
